questions.q:
What are the duties of the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) as Head of the Department of Military Affairs?
1. Permanent Chairman of Chiefs of Staff Committee
2. Exercise military command over the three Service Chiefs
3. Principal Military Advisor to Defence Minister on all tri-service matters
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explain: The CDS functions as the Permanent Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee and acts as the Principal Military Advisor to the Defence Minister on tri-service matters. However, the CDS does not exercise military command over the three service chiefs.

questions.q: Operations undertaken by the Army towards upliftment of the local population in remote areas to include addressing of their basic needs is called:
questions.explain: 'Operation Sadbhavana' is a humanitarian initiative of the Indian Army aimed at improving the social and economic conditions of the people in remote areas through various welfare activities.

questions.q:
Consider the following aircraft:
1. Rafael
2. MiG-29
3. Tejas MK-1
How many of the above are considered fifth generation fighter aircraft?
questions.explain: Fifth generation fighter jets have stealth capabilities and can cruise at supersonic speeds without engaging afterburners.\n\nAt Present, Fifth generation jets are possessed by Russia (Sukhoi Su 57), China (Chengdu J-20), and the US (F-35 & F-22). Therefore, none of the above aircraft are 5th generation fighter aircraft.

questions.q:
With reference to Agni-IV Missile, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. It is a surface-to-surface missile.
2. It is fuelled by liquid propellant only.
3. It can deliver one-tonne nuclear warheads about 7500 km away.
questions.explain: Agni IV is a surface-to-surface missile. It is an indigenously developed sophisticated two-stage missile having 4,000 km strike range. It is 20 metres long with a weight of 17 tonnes. Agni IV has two stages of Solid Propulsion, not liquid propellant. AGNI IV has a range of about 4000 km with 1-tonne nuclear head, not 7500 km.
